# Vantage Movers

Vantage Movers is a licensed interstate household goods moving broker serving customers planning long-distance relocations in the United States.

Important public pages:

- Home: https://vantagehomemovers.com/
- Carrier Contacts: https://vantagehomemovers.com/carrier-contacts
- Privacy Policy: https://vantagehomemovers.com/privacy
- Terms & Conditions: https://vantagehomemovers.com/terms
- Cancellation Policy: https://vantagehomemovers.com/cancellation
- SMS Privacy Policy: https://vantagehomemovers.com/sms-privacy
- SMS Terms: https://vantagehomemovers.com/sms-terms
- Accessibility: https://vantagehomemovers.com/accessibility

Compliance note:

Vantage Movers is a licensed interstate household goods moving broker. Vantage is not a motor carrier and does not transport household goods directly. Vantage coordinates and arranges transportation of household goods through FMCSA-authorized motor carriers.
